source_basis.notes: Research crosswalk based on supplied concept labels and local SAEE artifacts; not a mapping to a verified revision of an external specification.

claims.purpose: Associate an observed or declared action with an agent identifier.
limitations: SAEE records identifiers but does not independently verify agent identity authenticity.
No external identifier syntax or protocol is implemented.

claims.purpose: Distinguish one action instance and link related evidence records.
limitations: Alignment is conceptual and local to SAEE profile semantics.
No shared external action identifier format is implemented.

claims.purpose: Bind a stable digest to an action representation or action instance.
limitations: Existing SAEE digests cover receipt fields or retrieved content, not a canonical external action object.
No external canonicalization or action-digest protocol is implemented.

claims.purpose: Link an action or resource operation to an authorization decision.
limitations: A reference does not independently prove that the authorization existed or was valid.
No external authorization receipt format is implemented.

claims.purpose: Represent a human approval identity, context, scope, and time relationship.
limitations: The local profile evaluates synthetic relationship sufficiency and does not authenticate a real human.
Revocation, credential verification, and external approval protocols are not implemented.

claims.purpose: Order or associate action observations across a trace or receipt sequence.
limitations: SAEE has local trace and receipt objects but no external audit-trail wire protocol.
Observed sequence data is not automatically evidence authenticity.

claims.purpose: Combine independently described evidence relationships for one accountability question.
limitations: SAEE evaluates fixed local relationship profiles rather than a general external composition protocol.
Cross-organization trust roots and signature composition are unresolved.

claims.purpose: Report whether a receipt or evidence requirement passed a defined verifier.
limitations: SAEE result semantics are defined by local validators and are not external conformance results.
A profile PASS does not establish a real-world accountability claim.

claims.purpose: State the proposition that a collection of evidence is intended to support.
limitations: SAEE v0.1 reports profile requirement satisfaction while keeping accountability_claim_established false.
No legal finding, liability allocation, or external adjudication model is implemented.
